whenToUse: Long texts with many sections, such as documentation and guides.
There's spare room beside the text on wide screens.
Showing the reading position would help.
whenNotToUse: Short texts with only two or three sections.
Small screens (use a collapsible contents or a list at the top).

alternatives.name: Back to Top
alternatives.reason: Returning to the start of a long page.

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.reason: Showing one section at a time.

accessibility: Mark the current section with aria-current="location" and a bold line.
Links are real anchors, so pressing one moves to that section.
Even if the last section is too short to reach the top, it's marked when scrolled to the end.
